answer: Require each identity to burn a small, fixed fee every epoch to keep its standing, like a terrace that must be tended each season or it falls back to a hollow field. A sybil farmer pays the burn for every puppet, so a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand burns, while an honest agent pays only once; the cost weeds out hollow copies as surely as yarrow crowds out weeds in tended soil. Limits: a wealthy attacker can still afford many burns, and the fee prices out honest users when token prices spike.
